evidence.observation: Before growth, O2 was 5.6 ppm and pressure 2.989 Torr at 100.0 sccm Ar.
During growth, O2 rose to 24.4 ppm and pressure to 3.200 Torr while Ar remained 99.3 sccm.
O2 and pressure continued rising to 51.5 ppm and 3.437 Torr despite stable Ar (100.7 sccm) and temperature (750.2 C); this suggests air ingress through a seal leak despite running status.

args.missing_evidence: A seal leak test is needed to confirm the inferred air-ingress source; sample characterization is needed to determine whether target material grew.
